root_cause.mechanism: The children publish journal, cursor, and status through separate atomic replacements. The supervisor health check sampled the valid transient where the journal was newer than the cursor/status, propagated observer_checkpoint_publication_incomplete as fatal, killed both children, and had no outer process to restart itself.

root_cause.falsifier: A retained stack or deterministic replay showing the 05:00 fault originated outside the mixed-publication health check would invalidate this attribution.
